citations.quote: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. is experiencing rapid data center growth, with a 50% Y/Y increase in Q2 (107% Y/Y in data centers) and strong AI accelerator demand. I am upgrading AMD to Buy with a $1,000 share price by the end of 2028, due to the just-announced World Labs acquisition that is boosting AMD's AI intelligence. Strategic supply agreements with AI frontier labs and hyperscalers (like Meta), plus upcoming MI450x AI accelerator shipments, underpin AMD's growth thesis.

Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. maintains a Buy rating despite an 80x forward P/E and a 30% rally last month because a higher terminal value can justify its near-term high valuation multiple. The Data Center segment is expected to more than double its revenue YoY next year, showing strong growth acceleration and sustainability. Management now expects to significantly exceed the $20 EPS target within the strategic timeframe, implying a 75% EPS CAGR through FY2028.

Advanced Micro Devices Inc (NASDAQ:AMD, XETRA:AMD) agreed to acquire World Labs for approximately $8.2 billion, seeking to use AI model research to shape its future computing infrastructure. The all-stock agreement would bring researchers and model experts into the chipmaker to help develop hardware, software and systems for emerging AI applications.

news_evidence.counterevidence: No direct counterevidence appears in the supplied sources. However, three material unknowns exist: (1) the World Labs acquisition's dilution impact on near-term EPS is not quantified in any excerpt; (2) the 80x forward P/E cited in E1ca5094207 is acknowledged as stretched, but no source provides a revised forward earnings estimate post-acquisition; (3) no source reports current trading volume or its ratio to the twenty-day average, so the 'light volume' assertion in AMD-2 cannot be verified against the supplied data. The sources do not dispute the thesis conditions; they simply do not measure all of them.
news_evidence.reasoning: The supplied sources support both claims through multiple independent observations. Claim AMD-1 rests on sustained profitability and growth; the latest reported data show 50.1% YoY revenue growth and 17.25% operating margin, both well above the thesis thresholds (20% YoY and 12% margin). Current price (610.555 USD) remains 20.4% above the fifty-day average (506.96 USD), validating the price-above-SMA50 condition. Excerpt E1ca5094207 confirms Data Center revenue is expected to more than double YoY next year, with management targeting 75% EPS CAGR through FY2028, reinforcing growth sustainability. Claim AMD-2 cautions against adding at current stretched valuations on light volume; the World Labs acquisition (E1ca5094207, Ebe7d598def) is framed as a strategic, long-term AI infrastructure bet rather than an immediate earnings driver, which is consistent with the thesis that near-term valuation is stretched. The all-stock deal structure (Ebe7d598def) does not alter the current price or volume dynamics that define the claim's conditions. No source contradicts the fifty-day average price relationship or the profitability metrics.
